(unscoped).ability cooldowns: Detects the abilities you use and counts down their real cooldowns.
(unscoped).ability keybinds: Custom keys for your dungeon class Ability and Ultimate.
(unscoped).ability timers: Bound keys start countdowns, and running timers show on the Ability Timers HUD.
(unscoped).active profile: Shows which saved settings profile is loaded right now.
(unscoped).ap3: Cheat build: walks a hand-placed node chain through each F7/M7 boss phase.
(unscoped).armor recolour: Changes the colour, skin and trim of your armor, only on your screen.
(unscoped).arrow align: Shows how many clicks each Arrow Align frame still needs and can block clicks that overshoot.
(unscoped).attack indicator: Shows vanilla's attack cooldown under the crosshair (when vanilla's Attack Indicator option is set to Crosshair).
(unscoped).auto anvil: In Hypixel's Anvil, combines two identical single-enchant books into the next level, where the anvil can make it (cheat build only).
(unscoped).auto chocolate factory: Clicks for you while the Chocolate Factory menu is open (cheat build only).
(unscoped).auto clear: Cheat build: kills the starred mobs of the dungeon's mob rooms with your Hyperion or Spirit Sceptre (never melee). Switch on here, then start and stop it with the Clear Toggle Key or /autoclear. Stops when you move, jump or attack, in the boss, or when nothing is left; a server correction only warns you (chat and a sound) and it carries on.
(unscoped).auto correct: Fixes common typing mistakes in the chat messages you send.
(unscoped).auto dialogue: Cheat build: clicks the first option in NPC dialogue, skipping anything that costs coins.
(unscoped).auto door opener: Cheat build: right-clicks a locked Wither or Blood door once when you or a teammate picks up its key.
(unscoped).auto fairy souls: Cheat build: walks the island route and clicks each Fairy Soul for you.
(unscoped).auto gfs: Runs /gfs to refill dungeon items from your sacks when you run low (cheat build only).
(unscoped).auto mask: Cheat build: puts on your next death item (Phoenix, then the mask in Order) after Storm dies.
(unscoped).auto meow: Replies with a random cat line when a chat message says meow, purr, nya or mew.
(unscoped).auto puzzles: Cheat build only. Solves dungeon puzzle rooms for you; each puzzle's solver must also be on.
(unscoped).auto routes: Cheat build: records what you do in a dungeon room and replays it when you land on its start node.
(unscoped).auto sell: Sells items on your sell list automatically while a sell screen is open; start it with /autosell start.
(unscoped).auto terminals: Auto-clicks F7 terminals for you (cheat build only, against Hypixel rules).
(unscoped).bazaar flipper: Buys items from the Bazaar and sells them to the /trades NPC.
(unscoped).bottom arm: Shows the bottom line of the cross.
(unscoped).breaker aura: Cheat build: breaks the blocks you have picked (Pick Block Key) once they are in reach, while you hold a charged Dungeon Breaker. Nothing unpicked is broken.
(unscoped).center dot: Adds a dot in the middle of any style.
(unscoped).chat emotes: Replaces Hypixel's emote shortcuts in your messages with the real emote text.
(unscoped).chat keybinds: Keys or mouse buttons that send a command or chat message you set.
(unscoped).chroma: Cycles the main colour through the rainbow (keeps its transparency).
(unscoped).class overrides: Sets a player's class by hand for every feature in the mod.
(unscoped).click translate: Adds a click action to chat messages that translates them into your chosen language.
(unscoped).color on block: Changes colour while you are aiming at a block in reach.
(unscoped).color on entity: Changes colour while you are aiming at an entity in reach.
(unscoped).colour: The one colour every node marker uses while Uniform Colour is on.
(unscoped).copy chat: Shift+Left-Click a chat message to copy its text; Shift+Right-Click copies just that line.
(unscoped).copy code: Copies a short code for this crosshair to the clipboard, to share.
(unscoped).cringe: Run /cringe to send a random line from cringe-lines.txt, which you can edit.
(unscoped).crosshair preview: Your crosshair at its real in-game size. Click for another background, right click to go back; the strip below previews movement spread, recoil and target colours.
(unscoped).custom crosshair: Replaces the vanilla crosshair with the one you design here (both builds).
(unscoped).custom scoreboard: Replaces the sidebar with a custom styled scoreboard.
(unscoped).display options: Borderless fullscreen, fullbright, Pack Disabler and the Amber main menu theme.
(unscoped).door keys: Outlines dropped Wither and Blood Keys in dungeon rooms.
(unscoped).enchant colours: Recolours enchantment names in Hypixel item lore by tier, like SkyHanni.
(unscoped).etherwarp overlay: Highlights the block you would land on while holding an etherwarp item.
(unscoped).fairy souls: Tracks which Fairy Souls you have found and guides you to the missing ones.
(unscoped).freeze state: !! NEVER ON HYPIXEL - INSTANT BAN !! Freezes your character in place while your camera looks around freely (/freezestate).
(unscoped).gap: Space between the centre and each line; negative makes the lines overlap through the middle.
(unscoped).hide in menus: Hides the crosshair while a menu is open (chat does not count).
(unscoped).i hate diorite: Turns Storm's diorite pillars into see-through glass in F7/M7 (cheat build only).
(unscoped).import profile (open folder): Opens the import folder. Drop a profile .zip in and it is imported within a couple of seconds, named after the file.
(unscoped).inventory hud: Shows your main inventory as a HUD panel.
(unscoped).inventory search: Press Ctrl+F in any inventory to search; matching items get a red outline.
(unscoped).invert blend: Inverts whatever is behind the crosshair, like vanilla's. Use white for a full inversion.
(unscoped).item browser: Shows a panel listing every Skyblock item beside your inventory.
(unscoped).item protection: Turns on the guards that stop you losing your own gear.
(unscoped).item rarity backgrounds: Draws a rarity-coloured square, circle or outline behind Skyblock items.
(unscoped).leap menu: Spirit Leap settings: the custom leap menu, its Leap Order editor, and the party message sent after you leap.
(unscoped).left arm: Shows the left line of the cross.
(unscoped).livid solver: Outlines the real Livid on F5/M5.
(unscoped).loadout keybinds: Lets keys click loadout slots and change pages on the Loadout screen.
(unscoped).map, leap & party: The dungeon map, leap helpers, Dungeon Queue, Auto Kick and party sharing.
(unscoped).mask invincibility: HUD timers for Spirit Mask, Bonzo's Mask and Phoenix pet invincibility and cooldowns.
(unscoped).mod chat: Run /killer560 chat <message> to send a tagged message other mod users see as an overlay.
(unscoped).motion blur: Blends each frame with the previous ones for a motion blur effect.
(unscoped).object hider: Hides clutter such as fairies, support orbs, particles and dying dragons.
(unscoped).outline: Draws a border around every part of the crosshair.
(unscoped).paste code: Applies a crosshair code from the clipboard.
(unscoped).performance hud: Shows TPS, ping, FPS and a click counter in one movable HUD element.
(unscoped).posmsg: Each waypoint draws a ring and sends its own line to party chat when you walk into it (F7/M7 boss).
(unscoped).profile name: Name for a new settings profile.
(unscoped).profile viewer: Run /pv <name> to open any player's Skyblock profile in game.
(unscoped).quiver display: Shows how many arrows you have left in a HUD line.
(unscoped).real time: Shows a HUD clock with your real-world time.
(unscoped).recoil on attack: Kicks the crosshair outward each time you swing.
(unscoped).reset to default: Puts every crosshair setting back to the default look (keeps it on or off).
(unscoped).revert master stars: Turns the Master Star number on item names back into that many red stars.
(unscoped).right arm: Shows the right line of the cross.
(unscoped).rng meter overlay: Ranks RNG Meter rewards by coins per meter point.
(unscoped).rotation: Turns the whole crosshair. Multiples of 90 stay pixel-perfect.
(unscoped).save current as new: Saves your current mod settings as a new profile.
(unscoped).save preset: Saves the current look under the typed name, in the config folder.
(unscoped).screenshot copy: Copies each F2 screenshot to your clipboard (Windows only).
(unscoped).scrollable tooltips: Lets the mouse wheel scroll or nudge an item tooltip in inventories and menus.
(unscoped).secrets hud: Shows secrets found in your current room out of its total.
(unscoped).show in third person: Keeps the crosshair in third person, where vanilla hides it.
(unscoped).simon says: Highlights the Simon Says buttons you need to press.
(unscoped).size mode: GUI Scale: sizes follow your GUI Scale, and your monitor too while Auto Scale is on. Screen Pixels: one unit is one screen pixel on any monitor.
(unscoped).slot binds: Links two inventory slots so shift-clicking one swaps them.
(unscoped).smooth teleport: Glides your camera to where a teleport ability lands you instead of snapping. Visual only: you are already there, and what you aim at is where you landed.
(unscoped).spread when jumping: Opens the gap by the Spread Amount while you are in the air.
(unscoped).spread when moving: Opens the gap by half the Spread Amount while you walk.
(unscoped).spread when sprinting: Opens the gap by the Spread Amount while you sprint.
(unscoped).storage search: Searches your cached Ender Chests and Backpacks from one screen; also opens with /k560search.
(unscoped).style: Cross, T-Shape (no top arm), X (the cross turned 45 degrees), Dot, Circle, or Cross + Circle. Right click goes back.
(unscoped).terminal aura: Cheat build: opens any terminal in range during F7/M7 P3.
(unscoped).terminal solver: Highlights the correct slots to click in F7/M7 terminals.
(unscoped).terminal triggerbot: Cheat build: opens the terminal your crosshair is on during F7/M7 P3.
(unscoped).termism: Opens fake F7/M7 terminals to practice on anywhere; /termism opens it too.
(unscoped).thickness: How thick each line is. Sizes are rounded to whole screen pixels so lines stay sharp.
(unscoped).timers, score & boss: Run timers, score, run summaries, Blood Camp, chest profit and the boss helpers.
(unscoped).top arm: Shows the top line of the cross.
(unscoped).trajectories: Draws the flight path and landing spot of your bow shot or Ender Pearl.
(unscoped).translate: Run /translate to change the language, or pick it below; all your messages are then sent in that language.
(unscoped).video browser: Shows YouTube Shorts in a small window pinned over Minecraft (Windows only).
(unscoped).voice to text: Turns your speech into text and sends it to party or guild chat, by Push To Talk or Open Mic.
(unscoped).waypoint routes: Shows ordered waypoint routes for the current Skyblock area.

Armor Recolour.add helmet: Adds the helmet you are wearing to the list.

Arrow Align.aura: Cheat build only. Clicks Arrow Align frames in range without you looking at them.
Arrow Align.cheat build - automation: Cheat build: everything below automates clicks or aim for you, against Hypixel's rules.
Arrow Align.prevent misclicks: Blocks right-clicks on an Arrow Align frame that already points the right way.
Arrow Align.solve time: Posts how long Arrow Align took in chat when you finish.
Arrow Align.solver: Shows the solution for this puzzle or device.
Arrow Align.trigger bot: Clicks blood mobs and Arrow Align frames for you once your crosshair is on them (cheat build only).

Auction House.auction house browser: Turns on the custom Auction House browser, opened with /killer560 ah or a keybind.

Auto Anvil.auto anvil: In Hypixel's Anvil, combines two identical single-enchant books into the next level, where the anvil can make it (cheat build only).

Auto Blood Camp.aura: Turns your camera toward the spot a blood mob is about to land (cheat build only; needs Blood Camp on).
Auto Blood Camp.trigger bot: Left-clicks a blood mob when its countdown ends, if you are aiming at its spot (cheat build only; needs Blood Camp on).

Auto Chocolate Factory.auto chocolate factory: Clicks for you while the Chocolate Factory menu is open (cheat build only).

Auto Clear.auto clear: Cheat build: kills the starred mobs of the dungeon's mob rooms with your Hyperion or Spirit Sceptre (never melee). Switch on here, then start and stop it with the Clear Toggle Key or /autoclear. Stops when you move, jump or attack, in the boss, or when nothing is left; a server correction only warns you (chat and a sound) and it carries on.
Auto Clear.auto clear rooms: At the end, hand an uncleared room to Auto Clear and carry on once it is cleared. OFF: warp to it and hand control back.
Auto Clear.auto secret: Cheat build: secrets the floor with your Auto Routes - the reachable room with the most unfound secrets first, warping to its route's start node. Any movement key takes over. Needs Auto Routes on.
Auto Clear.auto secret key: Starts or stops Auto Secret (Esc clears it). Works only in a dungeon, outside the boss.
Auto Clear.autopilot: Cheat build: Dungeon Autopilot - Auto Secret, Auto Clear and Auto Puzzles under one planner. Each step it re-reads the map and score and picks the next route, clear, puzzle or door. Any movement key takes over; a server correction only warns you.
Auto Clear.autopilot hud: A status line: the mode, what it is doing, the score estimate and why it chose it.
Auto Clear.autopilot key: Starts or stops Dungeon Autopilot (Esc clears it). Works only in a dungeon, outside the boss.
Auto Clear.blood first: First clear the Blood Rush Split path and open its doors (wither doors with a key, then the blood door), then the rest of the floor by the Run Mode. Without the key it does the rest meanwhile.
Auto Clear.chat feedback: Chat lines for each room Auto Secret goes to or skips. Stops and server corrections are always said.
Auto Clear.do puzzles: Treat puzzles like rooms: go to one and let its Auto Puzzles auto do it. Only puzzles whose auto is switched on.
Auto Clear.ice fill first: When the floor has Ice Fill and Auto Ice Fill is on, go there first and let Auto Ice Fill do it.
Auto Clear.insta clear first: Before secreting, warp into uncleared rooms through entries the Insta Clear tracker KNOWS clear them. Never a guessed entry.
Auto Clear.key base range: Unverified: the wiki gives no base pickup range for dungeon keys. 1 block is vanilla's item pickup reach. The Magnetic Talisman was confirmed not to apply to keys, so the range used (shown after the arrow) is the base + 5 (the 0.27.2 bonus): 6 blocks by default. Set it to what you measure.
Auto Clear.puzzle wait: At the end, how long to stand in an unfinished puzzle for it to be done before moving on.
Auto Clear.route stall: A route with no node fired for this long is waiting for a walk nobody will make: stopped, and the next room taken.
Auto Clear.run mode: Solo: the best score per second toward 300, rooms, puzzles and only the secrets S+ needs, then the blood door last. Party: your routes first; clears and puzzles only when no route is left and no teammate is in the room; never the blood door.

Auto Close Chest.auto close chest: Stops secret chest menus opening in dungeons; the loot is still collected (cheat build only).

Auto Correct.auto correct enabled: Fixes common typos in the chat you send, like teh to the.
Auto Correct.correct commands: Also fixes typos in command names you type, like /wardorbe to /wardrobe.

Auto Dialogue.auto dialogue: Cheat build: clicks the first option in NPC dialogue, skipping anything that costs coins.

Auto Door Opener.auto door opener: Cheat build: right-clicks a locked Wither or Blood door once when you or a teammate picks up its key.

Auto Fairy Souls.auto click souls: Right-clicks each soul for you when it arrives.
Auto Fairy Souls.auto fairy souls: Cheat build: walks the island route and clicks each Fairy Soul for you.
Auto Fairy Souls.auto mode: How it crosses gaps it can't walk: Walk, Etherwarp, Fast Etherwarp or Pearls Only.
Auto Fairy Souls.auto walk path: Turns on the walking engine Auto Fairy Souls needs to move you.
Auto Fairy Souls.start/stop key: Starts or stops Auto Fairy Souls.
Auto Fairy Souls.turn speed: How fast the camera turns while auto walking, in degrees per tick.

Auto GFS.auto gfs: Runs /gfs to refill dungeon items from your sacks when you run low (cheat build only).

Auto Kick.auto kick: Warns or kicks when your run takes longer than the target time set for its floor.

Auto Meow.auto meow enabled: Replies with a random cat line when a chat message says meow, purr, nya or mew.
Auto Meow.play cat noises: Plays a cat sound each time Auto Meow replies.
Auto Meow.set: Applies the percent typed in the box as the cat sound volume.
Auto Meow.volume: Loudness of the Auto Meow cat sound, 0-200%.

Auto Puzzles.enable auto puzzles: Cheat build: master switch for the Auto Puzzles section; each auto also needs its own toggle.

Auto Routes.auto routes: Cheat build: records what you do in a dungeon room and replays it when you land on its start node.

Auto Sell.auto sell: Sells items on your sell list automatically while a sell screen is open; start it with /autosell start.

Auto Terminals.auto terminals: Auto-clicks F7 terminals for you (cheat build only, against Hypixel rules).
Auto Terminals.hover terminals: Cheat build only. Resting the mouse on a correct terminal slot clicks it for you.

Auto Trap.auto trap: Cheat build: plays your trap-room routes (New Trap, Old Trap) through Auto Routes - one etherwarp onto the route's start node to enter, no etherwarp inside, your route walks you out, and everything trap-related stops the moment you leave the room. Dungeon Autopilot does trap rooms only with this on.
Auto Trap.mode: Full Trap: the route that does the whole trap. Just Cleared: the route that only gets the room cleared. Each has its own captured route; this picks which one plays (Dungeon Autopilot Solo picks per score itself).

Auto Ult.auto ult: Uses your class Ultimate on chosen F7/M7 boss lines (cheat build only).

Bazaar.bazaar browser: Turns on the custom Bazaar browser, opened with /killer560bz or a keybind. Like Hypixel's remote Bazaar, it only opens while your Booster Cookie is active.
Bazaar.hypixel menu key: Hold this key while a reskinned Bazaar menu is open to see and use Hypixel's own menu instead.
Bazaar.reskin real bazaar: Draws Hypixel's real Bazaar menus (the Bazaar NPC, or /bz with a Booster Cookie) in this browser's look. Every click you make goes to the same slot in Hypixel's menu, so buying, selling, orders and claiming work exactly as before; screens it does not know stay Hypixel's own.

Bazaar Flipper.bazaar flipper: Buys items from the Bazaar and sells them to the /trades NPC.

Best Friends.party time tracker: Tracks time partied and dungeon runs cleared with each player; open it with /bestfriends.

Blaze Solver.blaze solver: Outlines blazes in kill order: red, orange, yellow, then white.

Blessings.blessings hud: Draws one line per blessing you have picked up while inside a dungeon.
Blessings.colors: Text colour of each blessing's HUD line.
Blessings.life color: Colour of the Life line on the Blessings HUD.
Blessings.power color: Colour of the Power line on the Blessings HUD.
Blessings.roman numerals: Writes blessing levels as V instead of 5.
Blessings.shown blessings: Which blessings may appear on the HUD.
Blessings.stone color: Colour of the Stone line on the Blessings HUD.
Blessings.time color: Colour of the Time line on the Blessings HUD.
Blessings.wisdom color: Colour of the Wisdom line on the Blessings HUD.

Blood Camp.blood camp: Tracks the Watcher's blood mobs and predicts where each will land.

Boulder Solver.boulder solver: Outlines the stone button to press next in the Boulder puzzle.

Breaker Aura.breaker aura: Cheat build: breaks the blocks you have picked (Pick Block Key) once they are in reach, while you hold a charged Dungeon Breaker. Nothing unpicked is broken.
Breaker Aura.choose breaker aura config: Picks which picked-blocks config is active, or creates and deletes configs (cheat build only).
Breaker Aura.open breaker aura folder: Opens the folder holding your Breaker Aura configs so you can share them.
Breaker Aura.reload breaker aura picks: Re-reads the active config from disk. Same as /breakeraura reload.

Chat Emotes.chat emotes enabled: Turns Hypixel emote codes like <3 or :shrug: into the real emote text, no MVP++ rank needed.

Chat Keybinds.chat keybinds: Keys or mouse buttons that send a command or chat message you set.

Chat Tidy.ability damage lines: With Hide Damage Messages on: hides lines like 'Your Implosion hit 2 enemies for 14,736,463.2 damage.' (any ability).
Chat Tidy.hide damage messages: Hides Hypixel's combat spam from the chat window: your ability damage lines and the hits you take. Other features still read them, and the log keeps them.
Chat Tidy.incoming hit lines: With Hide Damage Messages on: hides 'A Crypt Wither Skull exploded, hitting you for 23,760 damage.', 'Maxor's Frenzy hit you for...', '... struck you for...', 'The Lost Adventurer used Dragon's Breath on you!' and bone plating lines.
Chat Tidy.stack duplicate messages: When a chat line repeats the newest one exactly (same text and colours), the newest copy is replaced by one line ending in a grey (x2), (x3)... Blank lines and separators never stack.

Chunk Cache.chunk cache: Keeps chunks you've loaded readable in memory so the map, waypoints and solvers still see rooms you left.
Chunk Cache.clear cache: Throws away every chunk cached for the current world.
Chunk Cache.max cached chunks: How many chunks to keep in memory, 500-20000.
Chunk Cache.memory: How much of the chunk cache may stay in RAM.

Class Colors.class colors: Colors dungeon teammates by their class in the tab list and on nametags.

Class Overrides.add by name: Type an IGN and pick a class to override someone not in the party.
Class Overrides.add override: Saves the typed IGN with the chosen class.
Class Overrides.class selection overlay: Pick a player in the bar, then a class box, to assign their class on the class-selection screen.
Class Overrides.current party: Lists your party and their classes; click Override to set a different class.
Class Overrides.ign: The player's exact in-game name; case doesn't matter.
Class Overrides.other overrides: Overrides for players who aren't in your current party.
Class Overrides.override: Click to cycle this player's class override.
Class Overrides.override class: Click to cycle the class given to the typed IGN.

Click Translate.click translate enabled: Left-click any chat message to translate it.

Scrollable Tooltips.scrollable tooltips: Lets the mouse wheel scroll or nudge an item tooltip in inventories and menus.

Secret Aura.secret aura: Clicks nearby dungeon secrets for you (cheat build only).
Secret Aura.secret aura (dungeons): Clicks nearby secret chests, levers and Wither Essence for you in dungeons (cheat build only).

Secret Sound.secret sound: Plays a sound when you collect a dungeon secret.

Secret Triggerbot.secret triggerbot: Right-clicks a dungeon secret as soon as your crosshair is on it (cheat build only).

Secret Waypoints.secret waypoints: Draws a coloured box on every secret in rooms the mod has recognised.

Secrets.full block: Enlarges the click hitboxes of levers, buttons, chests and Wither Essence (cheat build only).
Secrets.lever aura: Flicks the F7/M7 P3 Section 2 Lights levers for you (cheat build only).
Secrets.secret aura: Clicks nearby dungeon secrets for you (cheat build only).
Secrets.secret sound: Plays a sound when you collect a dungeon secret.
Secrets.secret triggerbot: Right-clicks a dungeon secret as soon as your crosshair is on it (cheat build only).
Secrets.secret waypoints: Draws a coloured box on every secret in rooms the mod has recognised.

Secrets HUD.secrets hud: Shows the secrets found in your current dungeon room over its total, as a small movable HUD.

Sharp Shooter (i4).aim marker color: Colour of the i4 Solver's aim dots.
Sharp Shooter (i4).auto i4: Cheat build: aims at and shoots each target on the i4 device while you hold your bow.
Sharp Shooter (i4).cheat build - automation: Cheat build: everything below automates clicks or aim for you, against Hypixel's rules.
Sharp Shooter (i4).i4 leap: Leaps you out from the i4 spot to your chosen target (cheat build only).
Sharp Shooter (i4).solver: Highlights the i4 targets you still need to hit and draws dots showing where to aim.

Sim Settings.echoes of the lost: Dungeon Sim only: Dungeon Breaker charges each secret gives back. This is the Wither Essence Shop perk Echoes of the Lost (levels 1-5 restore 1-5 charges); 0 is off. Defaults to the maxed perk. The breaker still holds 20 and regenerates 2 a second.

Simon Says.simon says: Highlights the Simon Says buttons you need to press.

Slot Binds.slot binds: Links two inventory slots so shift-clicking one swaps them.

Smooth Teleport.smooth teleport: Glides your camera to where a teleport ability lands you instead of snapping. Visual only: you are already there, and what you aim at is where you landed.

Solver Highlights.through walls: Draws every solver highlight through blocks so you can see answers early.
Solver Highlights.waypoint style: Draws puzzle solver waypoints as an outline or a see-through full block.

Split Timers.split timers: Shows a HUD timing each part of a dungeon run.

Spotify Mod.chat destination: Which chat the lyrics are sent to: Party, All, Guild, or Co-op / Plain.
Spotify Mod.lyrics mode: Sends every lyric line, or only announces the song when it changes.
Spotify Mod.mod enabled: Sends the song you are playing on Spotify to chat as messages other players can see.
Spotify Mod.profanity filter: Stars out swear words in the lyrics you send.

Spring Boots.spring boots overlay: Shows how many blocks high your Spring Boots jump is charged to.

Storage Overlay.columns: How many storage panels sit side by side.
Storage Overlay.overlay theme: Amber (the original dark look), Dark (neutral greys) or Light, for the grid and the relocated inventory.
Storage Overlay.scale: Resizes the whole storage overlay, grid and inventory panel together.
Storage Overlay.storage overlay enabled: Shows all your Ender Chest pages and backpacks in a grid beside the menu.

Storage Search.storage search: Run /search to find items across all your cached storages, chests and menus.

Team Melody.team melody hud: Shows each teammate's Melody terminal progress during Phase 3.

Teammate Highlight.teammate highlight: Draws a box around each party member, coloured by their dungeon class.

Teleport Maze Solver.teleport maze solver: Colours the Teleport Maze pads to show which are used and which are likely exits.

Terminal Aura.terminal aura: Cheat build: opens any terminal in range during F7/M7 P3.

Terminal Solver.custom gui: Replaces the terminal window with a bigger centered panel showing only the slots you need.
Terminal Solver.hide completion chat: Hides the terminal completion lines in chat, including Terminal Timers' split times.
Terminal Solver.hide completion titles: Hides the terminal completion title and subtitle on screen.
Terminal Solver.highlight scale: Size of the terminal solver visuals, 50-500%.
Terminal Solver.label text colour: Colour of the small label drawn on highlighted slots.
Terminal Solver.melody: Detects the Melody terminal so Custom GUI and Auto Terminals can handle it.
Terminal Solver.melody button colour: Colour of the real buttons you click in Melody's Custom GUI.
Terminal Solver.melody endpoint colour: Colour of Melody's two fixed track endpoint panes in Custom GUI.
Terminal Solver.melody keys: Press 1-3 (1-4 on an old 4-row board) to click Melody's row buttons instead of using the mouse.
Terminal Solver.melody moving piece colour: Colour of Melody's moving marker pane in Custom GUI.
Terminal Solver.melody scale: A separate GUI scale for Melody, which has a much wider board.
Terminal Solver.melody track colour: Colour of Melody's static track background in Custom GUI.
Terminal Solver.numbers: Highlights the next two panes to click in the 'Click in order!' terminal.
Terminal Solver.numbers 3-tier reveal: Also highlights the 3rd upcoming click in the Numbers terminal, not just the next two.
Terminal Solver.numbers 3rd colour: Colour of the 3rd upcoming click in the Numbers terminal.
Terminal Solver.numbers after next colour: Colour of the slot after the next one in the Numbers terminal.
Terminal Solver.numbers next colour: Colour of the slot you need to click next in the Numbers terminal.
Terminal Solver.overlay colours: Colours the terminal solver uses for its highlights.
Terminal Solver.panel background colour: Background colour of the Custom GUI panel, always fully opaque.
Terminal Solver.panel border colour: Outline around the Custom GUI panel.
Terminal Solver.panes: Highlights the red panes to click in the panes terminal.
Terminal Solver.panes colour: Highlight colour for the Correct all the panes terminal.
Terminal Solver.reset colours: Puts every terminal overlay colour back to the default orange.
Terminal Solver.rubix: Shows which panes to click, and how many times, in the same-color terminal.
Terminal Solver.rubix count text colour: Colour of the click-count number in each Rubix cell.
Terminal Solver.rubix left click colour: Colour of Rubix panes you should left click.
Terminal Solver.rubix right click colour: Colour of Rubix panes you should right click.
Terminal Solver.select: Highlights every item of the requested color in the Select All terminal.
Terminal Solver.select all colour: Highlight colour for matching items in the Select all the [color] items terminal.
Terminal Solver.send mel coords on open: Sends your block position to party chat when a Melody terminal opens (F7/M7 boss).
Terminal Solver.send melody progress: Posts "Melody 1/3 - 33%" style progress to party chat as you finish each Melody row (F7/M7 boss only).
Terminal Solver.starts with: Highlights every item starting with the requested letter in the What Starts With terminal.
Terminal Solver.starts with colour: Highlight colour for matching items in the What starts with terminal.
Terminal Solver.terminal drop key: Stops Q from throwing your weapon while a terminal is open.
Terminal Solver.terminal protection: Blocks your first click right after a terminal opens so it can't hit the wrong slot.
Terminal Solver.terminal scale: GUI scale used while a terminal is open. Auto keeps your normal scale.
Terminal Solver.terminal solver: Highlights the correct slots to click in F7/M7 terminals.
Terminal Solver.terminals to solve: Chooses which of the six F7 terminal types get highlighted.

Terminal Timers.terminal timers: Shows terminal solve times and section splits in your own chat during F7/M7 P3.

Terminal Triggerbot.terminal triggerbot: Cheat build: opens the terminal your crosshair is on during F7/M7 P3.

Termism.open termism: Opens Termism, a practice screen with fake F7 terminals; same as /termism.

Terracotta Timer.terracotta timer: Shows a respawn countdown over each broken terracotta in the F6/M6 boss.

Thorn (F4).add stun spot here: Saves a stun spot on the block you're standing on.
Thorn (F4).cheat build - thorn esp: Cheat build: Thorn ESP extras below this line that see through blocks.
Thorn (F4).overkill chat: Posts each Spirit Bear's overkill count in chat when its ring resets.
Thorn (F4).overkill to party: Also sends each Spirit Bear's overkill count to party chat (/pc).
Thorn (F4).remove last stun spot: Deletes the most recently added stun spot.
Thorn (F4).show overkill: Adds an Overkill line under the Spirit Bear HUD for wasted spirit kills.
Thorn (F4).spirit bear color: Opens a color picker for the Spirit Bear highlight.
Thorn (F4).spirit bear counter: Shows how many Spirit Bears are left on your HUD.
Thorn (F4).spirit bear highlight: Highlights the Spirit Bear during the Thorn fight.
Thorn (F4).spirit bear hud: Shows Spirit Bear kills and a spawn countdown in F4/M4.
Thorn (F4).spirit bow color: Opens a color picker for the Spirit Bow highlight.
Thorn (F4).spirit bow highlight: Highlights the Spirit Bow that drops when the Spirit Bear dies.
Thorn (F4).spirit mob color: Opens a color picker for the spirit mob highlight.
Thorn (F4).spirit mob highlight: Highlights the spirit animals in the Thorn fight.
Thorn (F4).stun spot color: Opens a color picker for stun-spot waypoints.
Thorn (F4).stun spot labels: Shows each stun spot's name above its box.
Thorn (F4).stun spot waypoints: Draws your saved stun spot waypoints during the F4/M4 boss.
Thorn (F4).stun spots: Shows saved spots in the world where you stand to stun Thorn.
Thorn (F4).thorn color: Opens a color picker for the Thorn highlight.
Thorn (F4).thorn esp line width: Outline thickness for the Thorn highlight boxes, 1-10.
Thorn (F4).thorn esp style: How Thorn highlights are drawn: Outline Box, Filled Box or Glow; click to cycle.
Thorn (F4).thorn esp through walls: Thorn highlights also show targets behind walls (cheat build only).
Thorn (F4).thorn highlight: Highlights Thorn during the F4/M4 fight.
Thorn (F4).thorn highlights: Coloured boxes or a glow on Thorn-fight targets during the F4/M4 boss.

Tic Tac Toe Solver.tic tac toe solver: Outlines the best Tic Tac Toe square in green on your turn.

Tick Timers.tick timers: Shows a countdown HUD for the F7/M7 boss phases.

Timers, Score & Boss.auto blood camp: Cheat build: Blood Camp's Trigger Bot and Aura - they act on Blood Camp's predictions, so Blood Camp must be on too.
Timers, Score & Boss.auto close chest: Stops secret chest menus opening in dungeons; the loot is still collected (cheat build only).
Timers, Score & Boss.auto ult: Uses your class Ultimate on chosen F7/M7 boss lines (cheat build only).
Timers, Score & Boss.blessings: Shows your five dungeon blessing levels on a HUD and can announce each level up.
Timers, Score & Boss.blood camp: Tracks the Watcher's blood mobs and predicts where each will land.
Timers, Score & Boss.croesus / chest profit: Shows what each dungeon reward chest is worth, logs your claims, and (cheat build) claims the best chest.
Timers, Score & Boss.custom mage beam: In dungeons, redraws every Mage beam as one clean coloured line.
Timers, Score & Boss.dungeon esp: Boxes starred mobs, secret bats and the F7/M7 wither bosses.
Timers, Score & Boss.goldor triggerbot: Cheat build: in F7/M7 P3, clicks Goldor while your crosshair is on him.
Timers, Score & Boss.maxor's crystals: Phase 1 crystal helpers: timers, an unplaced-crystal warning, a counter and crystal boxes.
Timers, Score & Boss.p3 nav: Phase 3 navigation: boxes the next section gate and the terminals and devices you have left.
Timers, Score & Boss.p4 platform highlight: F7/M7 only: boxes the platform you mine through to reach Necron.
Timers, Score & Boss.rag axe: Ragnarock Axe helper with cast detection, timers and rag now prompts.
Timers, Score & Boss.run stats: Prints a per-player summary in chat after each dungeon run: rooms cleared, secrets and deaths.
Timers, Score & Boss.run summary: Records a summary of each finished dungeon run (splits, secrets, deaths, score) that you can reopen later.
Timers, Score & Boss.score calculator: Shows a live estimate of your dungeon score on a movable HUD.
Timers, Score & Boss.split timers: Shows a HUD timing each part of a dungeon run.
Timers, Score & Boss.terminal timers: Shows terminal solve times and section splits in your own chat during F7/M7 P3.
Timers, Score & Boss.terracotta timer: Shows a respawn countdown over each broken terracotta in the F6/M6 boss.
Timers, Score & Boss.thorn (f4): Helpers for the F4/M4 boss Thorn: Spirit Bear kill counter, highlights and stun-spot waypoints.
Timers, Score & Boss.tick timers: Shows a countdown HUD for the F7/M7 boss phases.
Timers, Score & Boss.wither dragons: Tracks the five M7 Phase 5 dragons with spawn timers, health and which one your class should take.

Trail.trail: Draws a cosmetic trail of squares at your feet as you move.

Trajectories.trajectories: Draws the flight path and landing spot of your bow shot or Ender Pearl.

Translate.chat translate enabled: Run /translate to change the language, or pick it below; all your messages are then sent in that language.
Translate.language: The language your chat is translated into; /language opens this picker.

Video Browser.video browser: Shows YouTube Shorts in a small window pinned over Minecraft (Windows only).

Voice To Text.voice to text: Turns your speech into text and sends it to party or guild chat, by Push To Talk or Open Mic.

Water Board Solver.water board solver: Shows a countdown above each Water Board lever for when to flip it.

Waypoint Routes.waypoint routes: Shows ordered waypoint routes for the current Skyblock area.

Weirdos Solver.weirdos solver: Outlines the correct chest in the Three Weirdos puzzle once an NPC reveals the answer.

Window Layout.full monitor borderless: Puts the window in borderless fullscreen on the monitor when using Full Monitor.
Window Layout.gap: Empty space in pixels (0-20) around the edges and between window slots.
Window Layout.monitor: Which monitor the picker tiles onto; Auto uses the monitor this window is on.
Window Layout.open layout picker: Opens a monitor preview; click a cell to move and resize this window into it.
Window Layout.respect taskbar: Keeps windows inside the monitor's work area so they do not cover the taskbar.
Window Layout.restore on launch: Moves this window back into the last slot you picked when the game starts.
Window Layout.windows per monitor: How many equal slots (1-9) the picker splits the monitor into.

Wither Dragons.king relics: Helpers for the M7 Phase 5 relics: spawn countdown, cauldron highlight and placement times.
Wither Dragons.wither dragons: Tracks the five M7 Phase 5 dragons with spawn timers, health and which one your class should take.
